desc:
Cage Fishing 🐟

UPDATES EVERY SUNDAY!

Build your ultimate fishing empire with with cages! Drop cages into the ocean, lure in wild fish and reel in monsters of the deep! Upgrade your plot for luckier catches, stack up rare loot, and SELL your fish to become wealthy! 💰

Flex MYTHIC and SECRET fish caught straight from the wild! 🎣

⌛ Sink your cages before leaving to keep catching fish while your away!

⭐Lagging? Join a free private server!

👍 Like, favourite and follow if you enjoyed the game!
